name: phpcoin-wallet-electron
description: Electron shell that loads the built PHP Coin web wallet from static files (../dist). Optional Vite dev URL via env.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,green "npm --prefix .. run dev" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:3001 && cross-env PHPCOIN_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001/ electron ."
scripts.preview: npm run build:wallet && npm run start
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:wallet && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
scripts.dist:linux:x64: npm run build:wallet && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:wallet && electron-builder --win nsis portable
scripts.dist:win:x64: npm run build:wallet && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64
